title: Book Two · Chapter 142: A Question After School
story:
After the next reading activity, Ronan waits while Miss Wu puts away the books. He has a question but no written slip this time.

“May I ask about the new group?”

“Quickly. I have another class soon.”

“Can I try after the guide mistake?”

Miss Wu puts one book on top of another.

“Yes. You can take the ordinary practice.”

“Will everyone know about the guide?”

“Some pupils know already. We will use your real practice record.”

Ronan watches her hands.

“Will you keep the old notes?”

“Yes.”

“All of them?”

“The record shows your first answers and your corrections. We keep both.”

He looks at his shoes. She waits for him to finish.

“I am better now.”

“You do some things better. In the new tasks, you will read and answer alone. Then we can see your own work.”

“Can I make a new record?”

“The new work goes after the old work. You do not need to remove the old pages.”

She takes the books to the shelf. Ronan follows with the last two. He puts them where she points.

Outside, Leo is waiting near the stairs.

“Did she say you can try?”

“Yes.”

“Good.”

“Can you?”

Leo puts his bag down for a moment.

“I am not sure about next year.”

“The other town?”

“My parents are talking about a different school again. Not now. Perhaps after the next school year.”

“Then why try here?”

“Because I am here now.”

Ronan looks at the passage. For a moment, he thought Leo might not try for a place here. But Leo still wants to try.

“Do you want to go?”

“Some days. Some days I want to stay.”

They walk toward the gate. Leo tells him the other school has a large reading room. But the family may live far from that school. The trip could be long.

“Nothing is just a large reading room,” Leo says.

Ronan nods. At the gate they meet Mei. She has borrowed a picture collection with permission. She has put her own cover around it. The cover protects the corners.

“Are you both trying?” she asks.

They say yes.

“So am I,” she says.

Now Ronan knows that both his friends want a place too. He smiles anyway.

“What are you reading?”

She shows them the collection. One page has a street with three doorways. The caption gives two names and one date.

“Which doorway?” Leo asks.

“That is what I need to work out.”

They stop by the wall for five minutes. Each looks at the caption. Ronan finds a small number beside the third door. Mei checks it against the words. Then she closes her cover and takes her book home.
studyGuide:
## 词句提示

record＝记录；caption＝图注；perhaps＝或许；protect＝保护。

## 理解问题

1. Miss Wu会因现在努力删除过去记录吗？
2. Leo为什么还想争取本校机会？

## 读句子

**Miss Wu / puts one book / on top of another.** Miss Wu／把一本书／放到另一本上面。
